canonical_title: Meta scaled back Project OT after AI-agent productivity fell short
treatment: Repeat only for new official restructuring decisions, quantified agent productivity evidence, or a renewed second-wave plan.
known_facts: Reuters reviewed internal documents showing Meta explored reductions of up to 60% in some teams under Project OT, not 60% of the whole workforce.
Meta confirmed Project OT and the two-wave scenario planning, but planning for the second wave was canceled before overall cuts were determined.
Reuters reports internal data suggested autonomous AI agents were not delivering the hoped-for productivity gains; Zuckerberg later said agent technology had not accelerated as quickly as expected.
reinclude_only_if: Meta publishes quantified productivity results for its agent-based workflow changes.
Meta revives or replaces the canceled second-wave restructuring with a material new plan.
A material workforce or organizational decision is officially tied to measured AI-agent performance.
notes: High-signal adoption/breakage evidence: internal enterprise agent deployment materially underperformed expectations and altered restructuring plans.
